selection_rule: Freeze all trial keys before pack/window evaluation. Among unambiguous whole-section modified pairs choose the first three keys by absolute required-only shared CF token delta, then lexical structural key. Pair each anchor as D02 with lexical key quantiles 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1 as D01, excluding equality. Append remaining lexical keys to at most six requests. Never use artifact hash or observed evidence position to select keys. Preserve the existing whole-section filler order and packer, source chronology, exact bands, and all gates.
